requirement: Design system: a Refero-only library with featured systems first, a pick at Add site that travels with the create request and is applied by the server once the site is up, signed-in and rate-limited preview doors that fail closed, apply and undo on a running site, and one shared history job for Site changes

oracle.invariant: 0 failures, 0 skipped across the ten files; every test named in run.tests reports ok. S1: the library is Refero-only, featured first in order, gate-refused featured never offered, 401 signed out and fail-closed without the sign-in check. S2: the pick is sent with Create site and applied server-side once, as the creator; a non-offered id is refused 400 before anything is created; no row without a pick. S3: preview doors 401 signed out / fail closed; over the per-account budget 429 RATE_LIMITED before any read; unknown and OpenDesign ids refused before any read. S4: apply then undo restores the template's own look on emdash, wordpress and joomla; a viewer is refused with nothing reaching the host. S5: concurrent history reads of one site share one job; finished/failed answers are not reused.
